SMTO-CFG-0097 — SMTO won't use this Skill for the current request

GUID: b84a0c2b-c85f-5fc4-b59b-0828638e2646
Slug: capability-activation-grant-declined
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: capability_activation

What happened

  • Earlier in this request, the Skill permission question was answered no, wasn't answered clearly, or clashed with changed settings. SMTO keeps that decision and carries on with the tools it is allowed to use.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If you're happy without the Skill, do nothing; the agent will carry on with other tools it is allowed to use. SMTO respects the earlier answer and won't keep asking the same question during this request.
  2. If you want the Skill, select Capabilities in the message box controls, set Apply to to This conversation, set the Skill to Auto, and select Apply. Turning the Skill on for the conversation lets new requests use it without asking first.
  3. Then send a new message asking SMTO to use that Skill for the work. The earlier decision belongs to the old request; a new message is a new request, so the Skill can be used.

What success looks like

  • The new request uses the Skill, or shows a fresh permission question you can answer.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details in this panel and send them to the person who manages SMTO so they can check whether something else blocks the Skill. Don't keep repeating the same message inside the current request; the earlier decision still applies to it.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Capability activation was blocked because the run already holds a denied, ambiguous or conflict grant for this Skill under the current task source digest.

What this means

  • Classification finds a prior denied, ambiguous or conflicting grant for this Skill and the current task's source digest. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • Classification finds a prior denied, ambiguous or conflicting grant for this Skill and the current task's source digest.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the retained grant outcome and current intent rather than repeatedly prompting for the same permission.

How to fix it

  • Inspect state.capability_grants for the Skill and the current source_digest; the decision is kept for that task source and is not re-prompted. To use the Skill, enable it in the conversation or global capability policy and start a new request (new source digest) rather than re-prompting the old grant.
  • This capability was declined or could not be approved for the current task. Continue with permitted alternatives.

Retry and execution caution

  • The reported capability or interaction condition changes.

How to verify the fix

  • Work continues within current permitted capabilities, respecting the retained decision.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass frozen authority, operation permissions or credential requirements.

Technical notes

  • The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
